results.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra Powers Faster, More Efficient Reasoning for Long-Running Agents | NVIDIA Technical Blog
results.content:
NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 55B active parameters built for frontier reasoning and orchestration in long-running agentic systems.
 The model achieves 5x higher throughput than comparable open models while delivering leading accuracy on benchmarks such as PinchBench, EnterpriseOps-Gym, Terminal-Bench 2.0, IFBench, GDPVal-AA, ProfBench, and Ruler at 1M context length.
 Nemotron 3 Ultra lowers the cost to task completion by up to 30% by using fewer total tokens and fewer tokens per turn on SWE-bench and Terminal-Bench 2.0. [...] ## Nemotron 3 Ultra for agent orchestration

Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 55B active parameters, built for frontier reasoning and orchestration in agentic systems.

Within any agent workflow, most calls are routine, but a critical subset demands deeper reasoning. Nemotron 3 Ultra is built to handle these hard calls: sustaining architectural decisions across coding sessions, synthesizing contradictory evidence across hundreds of research sources, or verifying chip designs across thousands of constraints. [...] However, these multi-agent workflows cause token counts to grow quickly. Agents plan, call tools, invoke sub-agents, receive information, and then pass history, outputs, and reasoning steps back into the model continuously. As tasks run longer, this constant communication increases costs and the risk of goal drift.

Developers can solve this using a system of models: frontier reasoning models for orchestration and complex planning, and efficient models for high-volume execution, validation, and tool calling.

NVIDIA is releasing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, an open model built to help long-running agents complete tasks faster while lowering cost.
